summary: A standalone role and its collection counterpart can coexist temporarily, for example in an RPM (Ansible 2.9+), by placing the collection in /usr/share/ansible/collections/ansible_collections and copying the role to /usr/share/ansible/roles, with the role using FQCNs for modules.
questions: Can I ship a role both as a standalone role and inside a collection?
Where should an RPM install a collection and a standalone role?

answer_card.title: Ship standalone and collection roles together
answer_card.answer_md:
For a transition period (Ansible 2.9+):
1. Install the collection under `/usr/share/ansible/collections/ansible_collections/`.
2. Copy each collection role into `/usr/share/ansible/roles/` under the standalone role name.

The role references modules/plugins by FQCN, so they're found in the collection. You could also split modules/plugins and the role into separate collections.
